official_evidence.conclusion: The official glossary defines attacks and counterattacks, Ward, attack and clash timing before combat damage, Bane including zero-damage cases, Drain, Barrier, damage and healing, destruction, banish, transform, Last Words, leader lethal, and empty-deck defeat.
official_evidence.summary: 官方帮助词条规定攻击与反击、守护、攻击时/交战时先于战斗伤害、0 伤害仍发动必杀、虹吸、屏障、伤害与回复、破坏/消失/变身/谢幕曲，以及主战者致死和空牌库败北。

official_evidence.conclusion: The official battle guide states that a super-evolved follower prevents damage and effect destruction during its controller's turn and deals one damage to the opposing leader after its attack destroys the opposing follower, including attack-time ability destruction.
official_evidence.summary: 官网对战说明明确超进化随从在己方回合将所受伤害变为 0、不会被能力破坏，并在攻击中破坏敌方随从后对敌方主战者造成 1 点伤害，包括攻击中由能力造成的破坏。

official_evidence.conclusion: The official card text for Katalina provides the production damage-cap case: incoming damage of four or more becomes three.
official_evidence.summary: 卡塔莉娜官方卡牌文字提供当前卡池的伤害上限实例：所受 4 点以上伤害改为 3 点。

official_evidence.conclusion: The official Balt Q&A says the opponent wins when both leaders are at one defense and Balt's all-leader crest resolves, demonstrating immediate lethal determination before the second damage.
official_evidence.summary: 巴尔特官方 Q&A 明确双方主战者均为 1 时由纹章持有者的对手获胜，证明第一段致死立即确定胜负并停止后续伤害。

official_evidence.conclusion: The official Victory Card glossary states that drawing from an empty deck becomes victory instead of defeat after the Reaper card at the bottom of the deck has transformed into a Victory Card.
official_evidence.summary: 官方“胜利卡”词条明确：牌组底部的死神卡变为胜利卡后，空牌库抽牌由败北改为胜利。
